show_work.caveats: One invoice can contain several categories, so orders by category do not add up to total orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-10' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-10-17'

show_work.definition: Gross revenue divided by the number of orders.
show_work.caveats: With a category filter this is category revenue per order that contains the category.
show_work.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-10' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-10-17'

show_work.definition: Number of distinct identified customers with at least one sale in the period.
show_work.caveats: Guest orders have no customer ID and are not counted.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-10' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-10-17'

show_work.definition: Share of identified customers in the period whose order was not their first order in this dataset.
show_work.caveats: The data starts in December 2009, so customers who bought before then look new. Early months understate this rate and inflate "new" customers.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND customer_type = 'returning' THEN customer_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-10' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-10-17'

show_work.definition: Returns divided by gross revenue, by value.
show_work.caveats: Returns and sales in the same period are not necessarily the same orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT -SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'return' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-10' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-10-17'

summary.text: During the retail week of 2011-10-10, total net revenue reached £204,251, representing a week-over-week decrease of -£96,056 or -32.0%, and performing -21.8% below the prior 4-week average of £261,171. Performance was driven by 448 orders, which dropped by -40 or -8.2% week-over-week while remaining +2.3% above the 4-week average of 438, alongside an average order value of £493.90 that fell by -£143.29 or -22.5% from the previous week and -18.9% versus the 4-week benchmark of £609.32. Additional metrics for the period included 360 customers, an 86.4% repeat customer rate, and a 7.7% return rate which was notably above the 8-week median. Geographically and by category, the primary drivers of business activity were the United Kingdom and the Signs and Wall Art sector respectively.
